_comment: How Intercepta results are judged. Source: https://docs.web3antivirus.io/reference/ (contents in spec/04-intercepta-official-spec.md).

All screening is on Base mainnet (chainId 8453): Intercepta's risk data is mainnet-only; payments settle on Base Sepolia. Which mainnet address stands in for each payTo is in config/policy.json (screening.targets).

address: traits tied directly to asset theft or sanctions BLOCK; suspicious-but-not-conclusive traits need the owner (ASK_HUMAN); no traits passes. The 15 trait names of ToxicScoreShortResponseV2 are all classified; an unknown name is UNAVAILABLE (BLOCK).
address: toxicScore is recorded and shown, but never decides on its own: the vendor publishes no threshold for it.
token: follow the vendor's recommended action (block -> BLOCK, warn -> ASK_HUMAN, info -> pass).
message: riskGroup values are not listed in the docs; they will be classified from verify-live results. Until then every riskGroup is unclassified -> UNAVAILABLE -> BLOCK (fail closed).
